gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Tenergy's TN480U charger-and-battery kits ship without a wall adapter. The charger needs a 5 V 2 A USB supply, and Tenergy's own 18 W kit provides one (5 V 2 A), so one Tenergy cart for $62.98 gives you a set that works out of the box.
standout_why: I compared against geekchamp.com/best-rechargeable-batteries-for-aa-and-aaa-devices-2026 (cited), which I read in full, and against IKEA's STENKOL/LADDA page (cited). Geekchamp lists Amazon Basics, BEVIGOR, Granicell, RayHom and Brightown with charge times and the rule that NiMH and 1.5 V lithium cells need different chargers. It says 'no charge current in amps or mA is stated for any product', it never mentions Tenergy, and it never warns that a USB-input kit comes without a wall adapter or names the adapter rating the charger needs. The IKEA page covers only the AC-plug STENKOL. I could not read the full text of two other cited pages: digitalcameraworld.com's page was cut off, and theconsumerlibrary.com failed with an SSL error. So I'm scoring 2, not 3. One of those two pages might mention the adapter, and the finding settles one item in the cart rather than which kit wins.
kit_items: Charger plus NiMH cells: the Tenergy TN480U 8-bay kit with 8 Premium Pro AA (2,800 mAh). It is sold as one SKU (P/N 90732) on Tenergy's store, an approved CJ program. Each slot charges an AA at 500 mA, and you can load from 1 to 8 cells.

Wall power: the Tenergy 18W Fast USB Charger Combo Kit. Its wall charger outputs 5 V 2 A, which matches the TN480U's 'DC 5V 2A' input. It also comes with two micro-USB cables. The TN480U kit includes only a micro-USB cable and states 'Micro-USB to AC power adapter is NOT included.'
Optional AAA cells: Tenergy's TN480U + 8 AA + 8 AAA combo (P/N 91257) instead of the AA-only kit. It still needs the same adapter.
Amazon alternative with no adapter problem: Panasonic eneloop K-KJ55MCA4BA, a BQ-CC55 charger with an AC plug and 4 AA cells. It's the set ChatGPT picked as best overall.

findings.product: Tenergy TN480U + 8 Premium Pro AA combo (P/N 90732)
findings.label: Price, stock and contents
findings.value: $42.99, in stock. Contains 8 AA, 1 TN480U, 1 micro-USB cable and a manual. 'Micro-USB to AC power adapter is NOT included.'
findings.source_title: Tenergy Combo TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger + 8 Pack Premium Pro AA Rechargeable Batteries
findings.note: Read from the maker's US store. The same page says it ships within 1 business day.

findings.label: Input and per-slot charge current
findings.value: Input DC 5 V 2 A through micro-USB or USB-C. Output is 500 mA per AA slot and 250 mA per AAA slot across 8 slots. Charging stops on negative delta-V. NiMH/NiCd only.
findings.source_title: Tenergy Combo TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger + 8 Pack Premium Pro AA Rechargeable Batteries
findings.note: Arithmetic: 2,800 mAh ÷ 500 mA = 5.6 h of current before NiMH charge losses, so a full charge takes at least 5.6 h. Tenergy publishes no charge time. A 5 V 1 A phone cube supplies 5 W, half the stated 10 W input. I have not measured how the charger behaves on a weaker supply.
